title: Landlord Withholding Security Deposit for 'Painting Charges'
narrative: I vacated my 2BHK flat in HSR Layout, Bengaluru on October 15, 2024 after completing my 11-month rental lease. I had given 1 month prior written notice via WhatsApp and Email on September 15. I handed over both sets of keys in person and left the flat clean and undamaged, with only standard wear and tear after a year of normal living. My total security deposit was ₹60,000 paid via UPI at move-in. The landlord Ramesh is now completely refusing to refund my deposit, claiming he had to spend ₹45,000 to repaint the entire apartment with luxury emulsion and ₹15,000 for deep cleaning and minor touchups. When I asked for contractor GST invoices or repair receipts, he shouted at me, blocked my phone number, and said 'Read your agreement, clause 14 gives me full discretion to paint. Do whatever you want, go to court!' I have the signed rent agreement PDF, bank transaction slip showing ₹60,000 deposit transfer, video of the flat taken on handover day, and WhatsApp chats.
